data_fields.name: first_attack_loot_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 (percent of total damage added to the first eligible attacker)

data_fields.name: drop_rate_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 9000 of 10000 (normal); 9000 for VIP; clips only a base rate that started below the cap

data_fields.name: vip_drop_increase
data_fields.donor_constant: 50 percentage points added to the bonus for VIP

data_fields.name: drop_roll_scale
data_fields.donor_constant: rnd() % 10000; a drop happens when the roll is below the rate (1 to 10000)

best_idea: Give loot priority to the top three damage dealers, with the first attacker getting a fixed share of total damage as a bonus, and roll each drop as a permyriad chance whose modifiers can raise the rate up to a cap that never lowers a base rate already above it.
decision_why: Take the owner list (first, second, third by damage, with a first-attacker bonus) and the permyriad roll with the cap rule into src/fight/loot.ts. Leave out the size, luck, class, race and item-boost modifiers until a ruling asks for them, because they are server-tuning knobs rather than fight design.
acceptance: In a three-player fight against one boss, the server's loot owner list is the top three by damage with the first attacker's bonus, and the owner gets loot priority; a drop with base rate 9500 out of 10000 is not clipped to the 9000 cap, while a base rate of 5000 is clipped to 9000 after bonuses.
